Open Developer Platform

The signed-in console, today and proposed

Every screen behind the login, captured from the live platform on 8 September 2026 and rebuilt in the FCG brand. Nothing has been removed: same routes, same columns, same filters, same actions. What changes is how it looks and how the empty and failure states read.

21 screens 14 developer view 7 platform admin Captured at 1440×1000 English only, for now

01

Console

The orange banner and rocket go. Empty states become the design, since a new developer sees nothing else for their first hour.

02

Getting Started

Same five-step debug flow, rebuilt on the brand's panels and mono type. Credentials stay masked until revealed.

03

App Management

Three products, three credential sets, one card each. Production access is a link, not a coloured button.

04

Sandbox Environment

Status moves into chips. The empty test log gains a route into Getting Started.

05

Request Trace

Nine filters in one pill row, four counters above the table, and an empty state that says what fills it.

06

Coverage Map

Density legend keeps the three bands. Counters carry the catalogue state.

07

Hotel Mapping

The three-step CSV pipeline reads as three steps. Batch history keeps its columns.

08

Hotel Orders

Sandbox and production as a segmented control rather than two buttons.

09

Flight Orders

Same columns, same environment switch, brand table.

10

Build My TMC

The four white-label templates become four selectable cards instead of one button.

11

SDK

Eight SDKs as one sortable table rather than eight stacked cards. Install command stays copyable.

12

Skills

Three packages, install command in the terminal block, tool support stated once.

13

AI Assistant

Conversation list beside the thread. The floating orange bubble is gone.

14

My Tickets

Counters, status chips, and an empty state that explains when to raise one.

01

Dashboard

The blue-to-orange gradient banner goes. Charts are orange on white; the donut no longer reads 'No data 100%'.

02

User List

Onboarding and access state as chips, so a pending account is findable down a 60-row list.

03

App Review

Six state counts as one strip. 122 requests, same columns, same actions.

04

Ticket List

Response-time counter added. Status chips replace coloured text.

05

Request Trace

The admin view of the same table: developer account filter, latency band, export.

06

SDK Management

Publish, version and retire in one row per package.

07

Docs Management

Swagger versions and guide pages as two counts on one table.

What is not settled. The console is English only; the Simplified and Traditional Chinese editions follow once the design is approved. Small orange labels sit at 3.56:1, below the 4.5:1 accessibility threshold, which is a recorded brand decision rather than an oversight. Admin rows are sample data.

How to give feedback. Quote the screen number and the view, for example “admin 03”, so a comment lands on one screen rather than the set.
